picks.headline: Hugging Face Reports Intrusion Executed by Autonomous AI Agent
picks.why: Marks one of the first documented real-world intrusions autonomously carried out by an AI agent against major ML infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous AI Intrusions Are Here: Lessons from the Hugging Face Compromise

picks.headline: OpenAI Outlines Safety Framework and Risks for Deploying Long-Horizon Models
picks.why: Provides official vendor guidance on emergent risks, failure modes, and containment strategies for autonomous, long-running models.
picks.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models

picks.headline: ShadowPickle Attack Evades Ten Model Scanners Across Four Hubs
picks.why: Demonstrates how Pickle Virtual Machine imports bypass modern model scanners, exposing fundamental security gaps in model distribution pipelines.
picks.title: ShadowPickle: Evading Machine Learning Model Scanners via Stealthy Pickle Deserialization Attacks

picks.headline: LLM Long-Term Memory Vulnerable to Persistent Insecure Coding Preferences
picks.why: Reveals that insecure coding habits saved in long-term memory resist safety warnings and drastically increase vulnerable code output.
picks.title: Insecure Coding Preferences in Long-Term Memory: Security Risks for LLM-based Code Generation

picks.headline: Bristol Myers Squibb Deploys First Life Science NVIDIA Vera Rubin SuperPOD
picks.why: Signals enterprise adoption of NVIDIA's next-generation Vera Rubin NVL72 architecture for domain-specific AI workloads.
picks.title: Bristol Myers Squibb Building Life Science Industry’s Most Advanced AI Factory on NVIDIA Vera Rubin

papers.headline: Enforcing Structured JSON or XML Output Collapses LLM Answer Diversity
papers.why: Reveals that forcing models to output structured formats like JSON or XML severely reduces response variation across 44 language models.
papers.title: Structured Output Collapses Answer Diversity Across 44 Language Models

papers.headline: Looped Mixture-of-Experts Transformers Achieve IMO Gold Without External Tools
papers.why: Proves that recurrently looping MoE parameters can match state-of-the-art reasoning performance while maintaining a compact parameter footprint.
papers.title: Loop the Loopies!

papers.headline: Sidecar Extractor Enables Composable and Compressed KV Cache Reuse
papers.why: Introduces a strategy to compress and combine long-context KV caches across sessions without updating frozen base model weights.
papers.title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
